National Laboratory of the Rockies press release, 2026-07-22 -- the announcement that names the project only in its headline
U.S. Department of Energy, Genesis Mission programme page -- launched 2025-11-24, $293M March 2026, $800M+ partner commitments July 2026
National Laboratory of the Rockies, 2023 -- Cordova Electric Cooperative microgrid digital twin (RADIANCE, $6.2M DOE grant). SEPARATE, EARLIER PROJECT

sourcing_note: Every figure in this dispatch comes from a primary federal document that was fetched and read directly, not from a search snippet. The AURORA-AI line is quoted verbatim from the DOE Office of Science awards PDF and confirmed independently on the National Laboratory of the Rockies Genesis Mission page. The Cordova figures describe a SEPARATE, EARLIER project and no source links it to this award.
